name: Olkasuchus
sum: Olkasuchus is a desmatosuchine aetosaur from the Norian Los Colorados Formation of Talampaya National Park, Argentina.
wsnote: No body-length estimate is given in the sources consulted.
holotype: PULR-V 246, an incomplete partly articulated skeleton with vertebrae, ribs, a partial right scapulocoracoid, humerus, pelvis, femur, tibia, fibula and osteoderms from the dorsal, ventral, sacral and caudal regions.
biology: The sources consulted give no direct evidence of diet or habits.
author: Sotomayor et al. 2025

sources.text: Sotomayor, J. C., Leardi, J. M., Desojo, J. B., Gaetano, L. C., Otero, A. and Apaldetti, C. Olkasuchus walasto, a new taxon of Aetosauria (Archosauria; Pseudosuchia) from the Los Colorados Formation (Upper Triassic), Argentina. Historical Biology 1-22.

dates_note: No PBDB occurrences. Norian (about 227-213 Ma) per English Wikipedia; whole ICS stage used.
